jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As a Senior Expert Corporate Production Management (m/f/d) at Exyte, you will play a key role in implementing and further developing our Lean philosophy across international projects.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Implementing Lean Design and Lean Construction methods across all project phases using PPM (Project Production Management), LPS (Last Planner System), and Exyte standard software.
- Training project team members and key users on Lean Construction methods, tools, and software.
- Continuously improving and optimizing standardized Lean tools and methods in close collaboration with stakeholders.
- Driving the transformation and development of high-performance teams by inspiring enthusiasm for Lean principles and production control.
- Acting as the first point of contact for all Lean Design and Construction-related topics within projects.

Show your expertise

- A degree in engineering or project management.
- Extensive expertise in Lean principles.
- 10+ years experience in construction projects and the implementation of Lean project delivery methodologies.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to facilitate workshops and trainings.
- A hands-on mentality and the motivation to drive sustainable improvements.
- Readiness to undertake regular weekly travel to our project sites for up to five days per week to support and train teams in the implementation of Lean principles and production control.
- Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken).

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues.
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks.
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team.
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working.
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor.
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany.

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

jobs.occupation: Environmental Test Technician (AIT) (m/f/d) (Techniker/in - Luftfahrttechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Akkodis is a global digital engineering consulting company that brings together technology and talent to accelerate transformation, drive innovation, and shape a smarter future. With more than 40,000 experts across over 30 countries, we connect industries and technologies - from AI and data analytics to cloud, edge computing, automation and cybersecurity.

Kundendetails

We are currently seeking a talented professional to join our team in Munich for an exciting project with one of our clients in the aerospace industry.

Stellenbeschreibung

- Execute thermal-vacuum and thermal cycling tests on spaceflight hardware
- Develop and implement environmental test procedures in collaboration with Test Leads
- Monitor, control and evaluate environmental test campaigns
- Maintain thermal-vacuum chambers and associated test equipment
- Define test processes and environmental test facility configurations
- Support the specification of environmental test equipment in collaboration with engineering teams
- Analyze test results and prepare technical reports
- Create and maintain procedures, work instructions and operational standards

Profil

- 3-5 years of experience in AIT, environmental testing or laboratory operations, preferably in the aerospace industry
- Experience with thermal cycling, thermal-vacuum testing and precision metrology
- Knowledge of space standards, environmental test setups and spacecraft qualification testing
- Proven ability to develop, execute and report environmental test campaigns
- Hands-on experience with metrology equipment such as CMMs and laser trackers
- Strong understanding of spaceflight hardware and environmental test requirements
- Willingness to work shifts and occasional weekends
- Fluent in English; German is an advantage

Das Angebot

- Team spirit and diversity
- Work-life balance
- Attractive compensation
- Employee benefits
- A wide range of training and development opportunities
- Team and sports events
- Global network
- Attractive employee referral program

Benefits may vary depending on the position and location. An overview of our benefits can be found on our website under the "Careers and Benefits" section.

Your Benefits:

- Work in an innovative environment within a forward-thinking, international team
- Opportunities for development and training in a dynamic setting
- Potential for transition to a permanent position

- 30 days of vacation

Your Duties:

- Project Responsibility: You take ownership of the conception, planning, implementation, and documentation of innovative software solutions

- Interdisciplinary Collaboration: You work closely with departments such as UX design, engine projects, quality assurance, and service

Your Qualifications:

- Mindset: You are not afraid to take ownership and demonstrate leadership, and you have a positive attitude

- Passion for Technology: You are eager to dive into the world of full-stack web and interface development and continuously expand your expertise

jobs.occupation: Information & Cyber Security Manager (m/f/d) at Allianz SE (Cyber-Security-Consultant)
jobs.description:
To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Allianz's strong inclusive culture encourages people to speak their minds, get involved and question the status quo. One means to cultivate teams with different perspectives is a regular rotation of Allianz Executive employees across functions, Allianz entities and geographies. Therefore, the company expects from its employees a general openness and a high motivation to regularly change positions and collect experiences across Allianz Group.
Who will you join?

The Allianz Group Information Security Function ensures that Information Security and Cyber Risks that may impact the successful delivery of Allianz business objectives are identified and properly addressed. It ensures that Allianz information is adequately protected, in line with legal and regulatory requirements. The Allianz Group Information Security Function maintains the Allianz Information Security strategy and related central investment program, oversees Global Identity and Access Management Governance and monitors and steers the Operating Entities globally across Allianz Group.

How can you make an impact?

Allianz is seeking for experienced and forward-thinking Information and Cyber Security Manager for the harmonization and alignment of cyber security investment budget and portfolio with projects conducted globally across Allianz Group and locally within Operating Entities. This role acts at the intersection of Group, Shared Services (Cyber Defence Center, Operational Information Security) and Operating Entities with understanding of cyber security, technology and financial services processes, it is responsible for ensuring that our digital environment is designed and built with security at their core, by design and by default.
As a key member of the Group Information Security team, you will drive strategic and tactical initiatives with focus on increasing detection within cyber-attacks, and act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders to ensure that security is embedded throughout the entire lifecycle of digital environment.

What are you made of?

What will make you succeed in the position:

- Educational Background: Degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Business Information Systems, Economics or related field is required. Master degree required
- Professional certifications in Information Security (e.g. CRISC, CISM, CISA, CISSP), Process and Service Management (e.g. ITIL) as well as Project Management (e.g. PMI, PMP)
- Practical experience in threat and risk-based solution design: Strong ability to apply threat modeling, risk assessments, and secure design principles to ensure that digital environment is resilient, compliant to law and regulation, and aligned with organizational risk appetite
- Knowledge of current IT and (related) security technologies and controls (e.g. Cloud, AI, Software Development toolchains)

What qualifies for the position:

- Successful track record in working for large and diverse international organizations
- Communication and Influence: Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex security topics to both technical and non-technical audiences and drive secure-by-design mindset across teams
- Analytical and Decision-Making Skills: Strong analytical and conceptual thinking with the ability to assess technical risk, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend secure, practical solutions in complex environments
- Strategic Thinking and Technology Enablement: Proven track record in translating business objectives into secure technical architectures, enabling innovation while maintaining robust cyber resilience
- Cross-Functional Collaboration experience, working with business stakeholders, operational security, enterprise architecture and development teams to embed security into IT and business projects and solutions
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

And there is much more: Allianz SE Benefits

To learn about our recruitment process: Allianz SE Recruitment Process

Apply before: 2 September- Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to withdraw the posting prior to the advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
In case of questions reach out to Ms. Daniela Lindig: +49 152 0926 1520

Welcome to Allianz SE!
We at Allianz SE are recognized as a trusted partner for protecting and growing your most valuable assets, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, including property and casualty insurance, life and health insurance, and asset management services, tailored to meet the various needs of individual and corporate clients worldwide. From our international headquarters, we orchestrate global operations, set strategic directions, and ensure cohesive implementation across our international subsidiaries. We are committed to innovation and digital transformation, driving initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency, reinforcing our position as a leader in the financial services industry.

Are you passionate about transforming data into powerful insights and driving smarter business decisions?

KWS Berlin GmbH is looking for a Data Analyst with focus on Source-to-Pay (m/w/d) who is keen on translating business requirements into analytics solutions and operating and optimizing data pipelines with strong governance and Master Data standards. This position is unlimited and available on a full-time basis (38 hours/week) in Berlin.

Your Responsibilities:

- Translate business requirements into analytics solutions and collaborate across the full project lifecycle.
- Operate and optimize data pipelines (ERP, S2P suite, AP, vendor master) with strong governance and master data management standards.
- Perform diagnostic and predictive analyses to identify value levers (e.g., price/volume variance, payment term optimization).
- Partner with cross-functional teams to define KPI standards, maintain data dictionaries, and ensure a single source of truth.
- Support process mining and advanced analytics use cases (e.g., Celonis) to uncover inefficiencies.
- Monitor and manage the Source-to-Pay (S2P) analytics landscape for stability, scalability, and compliance.
- Drive adoption and change management for analytics solutions across S2P.
- Build functional analytics capabilities within the S2P organization.

Your profile:

- Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
- Proven experience in Procurement, Finance, Source-to-Pay (S2P), or Spend Analytics environments.
- Experience with Master Data Management (MDM), data governance frameworks, and data quality monitoring.
- Solid understanding of Source-to-Pay processes and familiarity with SAP S/4HANA.
- Experience working with large datasets and translating business requirements into scalable analytics solutions.
- Desirable experience in Power Apps, Power Automate and SAP Ariba.
- Proficiency in BI tools (Power BI, SAP SAC, Datasphere) and process mining (Celonis).
- Strong SQL skills; Python or R is a plus.
- Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and proactive approach.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.

Our offer:

- We are an international team of open-minded people with diverse and cross-functional experience;
- Interesting and challenging tasks and projects;
- As a family business, we are guided by the values of closeness, reliability, vision and independence; this culture is lived in practice and ensures an open and friendly working atmosphere from day one;
- The best of both worlds: KWS Berlin combines the security of a large, stable company with the passion of a start-up;
- Our location in the heart of Berlin-Schöneberg is very modern; directly opposite the underground station Bülowstraße and with secured car & bicycle parking spaces;
- We offer 30d holidays, flexible working hours, holiday and Christmas bonuses, company pension scheme, JobRad and/or Jobticket;
- True to our motto "Make yourself grow", we support the professional and personal development of our employees.

We look forward to receiving your online application via our application system SuccessFactors! Please use the "Apply" function in the online advertisement.

We shape trust in the digital age!
At G+D, we are creating confidence, with built-in security tech in three segments: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. To our customers, we have been a reliable partner for more than 170 years. With our offering, we are well positioned to support them on their future journey. Discover our innovative SecurityTech solutions!
With our cash management and cash logistics solutions, G+D is driving the digital transformation of the global cash cycle. As a leading provider in this market, we support central banks, commercial banks, and cash-in-transit companies worldwide with innovative, secure, and highly reliable solutions.
As a Java Developer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing our mission-critical cash management and logistics platforms. You will contribute to the development of secure, scalable, and high-performance enterprise applications based on Java technologies, with a strong focus on the Spring ecosystem and modern software engineering practices.
In addition, you will help shape the future of software development at G+D by leveraging AI-assisted development tools and approaches. Working closely with your team, you will explore how coding assistants and AI agents can be used effectively, responsibly, and securely to improve productivity, software quality, testing, and documentation.
This role is based in Munich and offers the opportunity to work in a highly international environment. You will collaborate daily with an agile Scrum team primarily located in Gurugram, India, making strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset essential. If you enjoy working across cultures and contributing to globally distributed teams, we look forward to meeting you.

Your Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based enterprise applications with a strong focus on security, performance, scalability, and maintainability
- Contribute to technical design decisions, effort estimations, and architectural discussions
- Develop proof-of-concepts to evaluate and validate technical solutions and new technologies
- Collaborate closely with business analysts, testers, support specialists, and fellow developers throughout the software development lifecycle
- Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve technical issues and production incidents
- Apply and promote AI-assisted software development practices, ensuring responsible usage and validation of AI-generated results
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of our cross-functional agile team, fostering engineering excellence, built-in quality, test-driven development, security-by-design, and AI-first approaches
- Support knowledge sharing and actively contribute to a culture of continuous learning and innovation

Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of professional experience in Java software development
- Strong expertise in Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate/JPA, EJB, and RESTful APIs
- Experience with enterprise application servers such as WebSphere or JBoss
- Solid understanding of object-oriented design principles, software architecture, and enterprise application development
- Hands-on experience with non-functional requirements, including security, performance optimization, scalability, and automated testing
- Experience with relational databases such as Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization and performance tuning
- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and a strong understanding of responsible AI usage, security considerations, and result validation
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
- Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international environment

jobs.occupation: Head of Global Business Operations (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Operationsdienst)
jobs.description:
Drive Operational Excellence. Create Business Value. Shape Global Transformation.

At KWS, we are transforming the way global business services create value for our organization. As Head of Global Business Operations (GBO) (m/f/d), you will have the unique opportunity to shape a globally integrated operating model, drive digital transformation at scale, and partner directly with the CFO to enhance efficiency, service excellence, and business performance worldwide.

You will lead KWS' GBO organization with end-to-end accountability for our core administrative processes, including Record-to-Report (R2R), Source-to-Pay (S2P), and Order-to-Cash (O2C), ensuring operational excellence, scalability, and sustainable value creation across the enterprise.

Your Responsibilities:

Lead Global Business Operations

- Define and execute the strategic direction of Global Business Operations in alignment with KWS' business objectives.
- Lead a high-performing global organization with accountability for service delivery, operational performance, quality, and continuous improvement.
- Serve as a trusted partner to the CFO and senior business leaders, driving organizational effectiveness and business value.
- Own and Optimize End-to-End Processes - Provide global ownership and continuous improvement for key business processes: Record-to-Report (R2R), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C)
- You will establish clear governance structures, accountabilities, service standards, and performance expectations across functions, countries, and systems to ensure scalable and efficient process execution.

Drive Service Excellence and Business Performance

- Deliver reliable, high-quality services following a “first time right” approach.
- Define and manage KPIs, SLAs, and performance dashboards to drive transparency and accountability.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and simplify processes.
- Generate actionable insights that support informed decision-making and business performance.

Lead Digital Transformation

- Drive the adoption of SAP S/4HANA, automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and AI-enabled technologies.
- Partner closely with Digital & IT, Global Process Owners, and business stakeholders to standardize processes and improve data quality.
- Develop and execute a transformation roadmap that balances innovation with operational stability.

Ensure Governance, Compliance and Risk Management

- Maintain a robust control environment across all GBO processes.
- Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
- Drive process transparency, accountability, and effective risk management across the end-to-end value chain.

Build a Future-Ready Organization

- Inspire, develop, and empower a global leadership team.
- Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer orientation, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Budget and Resource Management

- Own the annual budget and strategic priorities for the GBO.
- Ensure efficient allocation of resources and delivery of operational and financial targets.
- Evaluate and sponsor business cases supporting service enhancements and transformation initiatives.

Your Profile:

Professional Experience

- Advanced degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field.
- Significant leadership experience in Global Business Operations, Shared Services, Finance Operations, Procurement, Order Management, or comparable functions.
- Proven track record in leading large-scale operational and transformation initiatives within international organizations.
- Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, particularly R2R, S2P, and OTC.
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA and digital transformation, automation, analytics, or AI-enabled solutions.
- Demonstrated success in leading within complex global matrix organizations.

Leadership Competencies

- Strategic and operational leader with a strong service and quality mindset.
- Ability to translate business priorities into scalable operational solutions.
- Strong analytical and fact-based decision-making skills.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing capabilities.
- Proven ability to drive transformation while maintaining operational excellence.
- Inclusive leadership style with a focus on trust, accountability, and people development.

Languages

- Fluent in English.
- German and additional languages are an advantage.

What We Offer:

- A highly visible and strategic leadership role with global responsibility.
- Direct partnership with the CFO and senior leadership team.
- Significant influence on the future development of KWS’ global operating model.
- The opportunity to shape process excellence, digital transformation, and organizational effectiveness on a global scale.
- An international, collaborative, and innovative working environment with substantial scope for impact and leadership.

We welcome applications from leaders who are ready to drive performance and transformation at scale. We look forward to receiving your application!

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d), you will support recruiting activities for Gas Services while partnering closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and a global Talent Acquisition network. Beyond leading day-to-day recruiting operations, you will drive recruiting projects, mentor recruiters, and continuously improve recruiting efficiency and delivery. This role offers a long-term career path with the opportunity to grow into a broader Talent Acquisition leadership position within Gas Services as organizational responsibilities evolve.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Strategic partnership with business leaders and hiring managers across a complex global matrix organization to develop and execute recruiting strategies aligned with business priorities
* Operational leadership and coaching of project teams, ensuring effective workload allocation, capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery against KPIs and service level expectations
* Leadership of Talent Acquisition projects and support of organizational transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across the global Talent Acquisition organization
* Analysis of recruiting metrics and market insights to identify optimization opportunities and drive data-informed decisions that enhance recruiting effectiveness and process excellence
* End-to-end management of recruiting activities across a broad range of functions and position levels, including both tariff and non-tariff roles, while ensuring an outstanding candidate and hiring manager experience
* Close collaboration with HR, Works Councils, business leaders, and global stakeholders to provide guidance on recruiting processes, governance, labor relations, and talent acquisition strategies

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Extensive Talent Acquisition experience with a strong end-to-end recruiting generalist background, ideally gained within a global industrial or corporate environment
* Proven experience leading recruiting projects and successfully navigating complex matrix organizations with multiple stakeholder groups
* Strong project management skills and experience driving recruiting or organizational transformation initiatives.
* High data affinity with the ability to interpret recruiting metrics, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions using applicant tracking systems and recruiting analytics
* Sound understanding of collective bargaining agreements (tariff structures), experience collaborating with Works Councils, and familiarity with governance processes in a corporate environment
* Professional proficiency in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
